arguments.sql: SELECT j.JRNL_NO, SUM(l.DR_AMT) AS dr, SUM(l.CR_AMT) AS cr, SUM(l.DR_AMT)-SUM(l.CR_AMT) AS diff FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLJRNH" j ON j.JRNL_NO=l.JRNL_NO GROUP BY j.JRNL_NO HAVING SUM(l.DR_AMT)<>SUM(l.CR_AMT)

SELECT i.INV_ID, i.INV_NO, i.VEND_CD, i.INV_AMT, i.JRNL_NO, j.DR_T, j.CR_T FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN (SELECT JRNL_NO, SUM(DR_AMT) DR_T, SUM(CR_AMT) CR_T FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY JRNL_NO) j ON j.JRNL_NO=i.JRNL_NO WHERE j.JRNL_NO IS NULL OR ROUND(j.DR_T,2)<>ROUND(i.INV_AMT,2)

SELECT x.INV_NO_N, x.VEND_N, COUNT(*) n, STRING_AGG(CAST(x.INV_ID AS TEXT), ',') ids FROM (SELECT INV_ID, UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(INV_NO),'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')) INV_NO_N, UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(VEND_CD),'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')) VEND_N FROM "APINVH") x GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1

SELECT l.JRNL_NO, h.PRD_ID, h.POST_DT, p.PRD_ID AS cur_prd, p.STRT_DT, p.END_DT, p.CLOSE_DT, p.STAT_CD FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l.JRNL_NO=h.JRNL_NO JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p.PRD_ID=h.PRD_ID WHERE h.POST_DT NOT BETWEEN p.STRT_DT AND p.END_DT OR (p.STAT_CD='C' AND h.POST_DT>p.CLOSE_DT) GROUP BY l.JRNL_NO, h.PRD_ID, h.POST_DT, p.PRD_ID, p.STRT_DT, p.END_DT, p.CLOSE_DT, p.STAT_CD

SELECT p.PAY_ID, p.INV_ID, p.PAY_AMT, i.INV_AMT, i.STAT_CD FROM "APPAYM" p LEFT JOIN "APINVH" i ON i.INV_ID=p.INV_ID WHERE i.INV_ID IS NULL OR i.STAT_CD NOT IN ('P','O') OR p.INV_ID IN (SELECT INV_ID FROM "APPAYM" GROUP BY INV_ID HAVING SUM(PAY_AMT)>0 AND SUM(PAY_AMT)<>0) AND 1=0 UNION ALL SELECT NULL, i.INV_ID, SUM(p.PAY_AMT), i.INV_AMT, i.STAT_CD FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "APPAYM" p ON p.INV_ID=i.INV_ID GROUP BY i.INV_ID, i.INV_AMT, i.STAT_CD HAVING ROUND(SUM(p.PAY_AMT),2)<>ROUND(i.INV_AMT,2)

SELECT h.JRNL_NO, h.SRC_CD, h.SRC_REF, h.POST_FLG, h.REF_JRNL_NO, h.POST_DT FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h.REF_JRNL_NO IS NOT NULL OR h.JRNL_NO NOT IN (SELECT JRNL_NO FROM "GLJRNL") OR h.POST_FLG<>'P' ORDER BY 1
SELECT l.JRNL_NO, l.ACCT_CD, c.ACCT_CD AS coa FROM "GLJRNL" l LEFT JOIN "GLCOA" c ON TRIM(c.ACCT_CD)=TRIM(l.ACCT_CD) WHERE c.ACCT_CD IS NULL OR c.ACTV_FLG<>'Y'
